rule.name: CAW_constructCoreChartDataByGroup
rule.description: Constructs the necessary data format for the Core ASK Actual report charts by group
rule.definition: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: #"_a-0000e825-ace1-8000-9c24-011c48011c48_6905917", expression: a!localVariables( local!actualIdsForGroup: #"_a-0000e825-ace1-8000-9c24-011c48011c48_6906592"( group: fv!item ), local!plan: if( a!isNullOrEmpty(ri!plan), 0, sum( index( index(ri!plan, "headCountAmount", {}), wherecontains( local!actualIdsForGroup, index(ri!plan, "dppGroupId", {}) ) ) ) ), local!actual: if( a!isNullOrEmpty(ri!actualNominations), {}, index( ri!actualNominations, wherecontains( local!actualIdsForGroup, index(ri!actualNominations, "dppGroupId", {}) ) ) ), local!confirmed: length( index( local!actual, wherecontains( #"_a-0000e72d-09a6-8000-9c0e-011c48011c48_5076350", tointeger(index(local!actual, "statusId", {})) ) ) ), local!inProcess: length(local!actual) - local!confirmed, a!map( group: fv!item, plan: local!plan, confirmed: local!confirmed, inProcess: local!inProcess, open: if( local!plan - sum(local!confirmed, local!inProcess) < 0, 0, local!plan - sum(local!confirmed, local!inProcess) ) ) ) )
